author: Unreal Engine
description:
Watch this session recorded at Unreal Fest Chicago 2026 to discover how to elevate the way your characters convey emotion in real time. 

You’ll learn how to build richly expressive character rigs in Unreal Engine using the latest shape authoring tools and deformers. This session explores how to design clean controls, sculpt nuanced emotional motion, and blend bone-based systems with blend shapes. Press play to see practical techniques for achieving stylized expression that performs in both cinematic and gameplay contexts.

Find out about using Unreal Engine for animation here: unrealengine.com/uses/animation

title: Building Cartoony Facial Rigs with Control Rig in Unreal Engine | Unreal Fest Chicago 2026

author: Unreal Engine
description:
Watch this session recorded at Unreal Fest Chicago 2026 and learn about how The Coalition—home of the ‘Gears of War’ franchise—established the Xbox Games Technology Group (XGTG), an Unreal Engine-focused shared technology group within Xbox. 

XGTG exists to help advance game development across Xbox by sharing technology, improving performance and memory on titles, sharing guidance and best practices, and promoting collaborations—all to enable studios to build higher‑quality games more efficiently. 

In this talk, Phil Cousins, Technical Director for XGTG, walks through how the team was established and shares the impact it’s having today. He explains how they share technology, including examples of key systems, features, and workflows other teams have adopted. He also discusses how they handle performance engagements with titles and how they share their learnings across all studios.
